entities.name: Francis E. McGovern
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francis Edward McGovern was an American lawyer and politician from Wisconsin. He served as the 22nd governor of Wisconsin from 1911 to 1915. In 1911 especially he sponsored a major series of progressive achievements through the legislature.
